jobDesc: Developed a dating-matching platform and an interest-based "activity meetup" community app, connecting users with shared interests and enabling in-person gatherings.
Involved throughout requirement planning, flow and UI design, AI implementation, and the iOS App Store release.
AI implementation: applied Claude to match suggestions, chat coaching, icebreaker topics, and automatically generated bios.
Content-moderation and safety module: AWS Rekognition (synchronous for images, asynchronous for video), sensitive-word filtering, and real-person face verification.
Flutter cross-platform app with a NestJS / TypeScript backend (180+ APIs, 1,066 automated tests, Redis caching and MySQL index optimization), packaged and deployed with Docker.
Defined a North Star Metric, conducted competitive analysis, and consolidated the feature set through subtraction (4-tab information architecture, data-model normalization).
Responsible for backend architecture design and technical decisions across several game and platform products, covering real-time systems, asynchronous flows, and high-concurrency scenarios.
Built backend services in Node.js / TypeScript, performed MySQL performance optimization and Redis caching design, and handled deployment and debugging on Linux / Docker.

Assessed risk, performance, and scalability at the architecture level, identified bottlenecks and proposed improvements, including asynchronous processing, resource allocation, and system load optimization.
Used logs, metrics, and behavioral data for system observability and issue diagnosis.
Introduced design review, code review, and release checklists to establish implementation standards.
Contributed to the development and operation of multiple backend systems, including games, lotteries, blockchain fair random numbers, crawler data, and admin dashboards.
Responsible for system analysis, backend implementation, code refactoring, and performance optimization, restructuring inherited legacy code into a more maintainable module architecture.
Took part in requirement planning, clarifying business logic and implementation approaches.
Provided API documentation, Postman examples, and supporting technical documents.
Contributed to several commercial system projects, including lending systems, a video streaming platform, an equipment repair system, and e-commerce modules.
Lending system: responsible for backend core development and data flow design (Node.js / NestJS / MySQL), ensuring the correctness of transaction flows and data.
Video streaming platform: involved in frontend-backend integration and architecture planning, and responsible for the automated deployment pipeline.
Reduced module coupling by separating frontend and backend responsibilities and revising API design, and established unit and functional testing processes.
Collaborated with product and business units to translate requirements into actionable technical solutions.
